name: nx-rule-schedule-browser
description: Browser sample: list event rules and set a rule's SCHEDULE over /rest/v4/events/rules (GET) + /rest/v4/events/rules/{id} (PATCH), in BOTH auth modes (direct VMS server, cloud account via relay), with a zero-dependency dev proxy that forwards the method + JSON body + bearer and re-attaches them across the relay 307.
